Name: Show Missing Collection Entries
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod makes it easier to figure out which items, recipes, achievements, and powers you are missing from the various collections.

Various things you can show / hide:

[list]
[*]Missing Item Icons (default = true)[/*]
[*]Missing Item Names (default = true)[/*]
[*]Missing Item Details (default = false)[/*]
[*]Missing Achievement Names (default = true)[/*]
[*]Missing Achievement Details (default = false)[/*]
[*]Missing Recipe Tint (default = reddish)[/*]
[*]Missing Power Icons (default = true)[/*]
[*]Missing Power Names (default = true)[/*]
[*]Missing Power Descriptions (default = false)[/*]
[/list]
Showing achievement names and detail only affects those that would normally show up as "???".

Recipe color tint is necessary to differentiate from recipes that were learned but never cooked.


[size=5][u][b]Technical[/b][/u][/size]

Requires SMAPI.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
